title: Describe an approved device’s permissions
responsibility: Builds the action permissions for a device allowed to read and comment on a computer’s project.

inputs.name: deviceCapabilities.agents
inputs.description: Whether the approved device is also allowed to use agents. This value controls agent, planning and approval actions together.

outputs.name: deviceCapabilities
outputs.description: Capabilities with comments enabled and local as the source. Agents, planning and approval equal the supplied flag. The reason explains read-and-comment-only access when false, or that comments remain pending on the computer until connected when true.
